text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's going on? I can feel power welling up within me?! My body's heating up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: O Three Goddesses. I know not whether you are the ones responsible for this boost…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But I shall not let this support go to waste. I will keep on running—with all this strength!
